_comment: Rules for recommend_setup. A rule matches when ANY signal in `when` is present in the project. weight (default 1) ranks rules inside a category. Add or change rules by PR. Signals are produced by lib/recommend.js (scanProject).

rules.name: Add a CLAUDE.md
rules.why: The project has no CLAUDE.md. A short file with build/test commands and conventions is what every new session reads first. Run /init to draft one.

rules.name: context7 (live library docs)
rules.why: Your dependencies change faster than the model's training data; this looks up current docs for the libraries you use.

rules.name: Playwright (browser automation)
rules.why: A frontend project benefits from driving a real browser to check the UI it just changed.

rules.name: Supabase
rules.why: The project uses Supabase; the MCP server can inspect schema and run queries directly.

rules.name: GitHub
rules.why: The project is a git repo with GitHub Actions; issues, PRs and workflow runs become readable from the session.

rules.name: Sentry
rules.why: The project reports errors to Sentry; the MCP server lets the session read the actual error events.

rules.name: Frontend design skill
rules.why: A UI framework is in use; a design skill raises the baseline quality of generated interfaces.

rules.name: Web app testing skill
rules.why: The project has a web UI and tests; a skill that drives the app in a browser helps verify changes.

rules.name: MCP server builder skill
rules.why: The project talks to model APIs; if you build tools for an agent, this skill covers MCP server conventions.

rules.name: Skill creator
rules.why: Turn a workflow you repeat in this project into a reusable skill.

rules.name: Format files after each edit (PostToolUse)
rules.why: A formatter is configured in the project, so a PostToolUse hook can run it on every file Claude edits and keep diffs clean.

rules.name: Lint after each edit (PostToolUse)
rules.why: A linter is configured; running it after edits surfaces problems while the change is still in context.

rules.name: Block edits to env/secret files (PreToolUse)
rules.why: The project has env files. A PreToolUse hook can refuse writes to them so secrets are never touched by accident.

rules.name: Run the tests when Claude finishes (Stop)
rules.why: The project has a test suite; a Stop hook that runs it catches regressions before you look at the result.

rules.name: Code reviewer subagent
rules.why: A read-only reviewer that checks a diff against the project's tests and conventions, run in its own context.

rules.name: Security reviewer subagent
rules.why: The project handles payments, auth-adjacent APIs or a database; a focused security pass is worth its own agent.

rules.name: /test slash command
rules.why: A one-word command that runs the project's tests and summarizes failures.

rules.name: /pr-review slash command
rules.why: A repeatable pull-request checklist for a repo that uses GitHub Actions.
